name: capsule_revolve_with_arc_sketch
description: A capsule-like revolved solid with rounded hemispherical ends represented by true sketch arc segments.
source_license: Project-authored example; not from an external dataset.
derived_by: Hand-authored from validated Prompt2ParametricCAD sketch-arc revolve behavior.
construction_plan: Use a sketch profile when the revolved outline needs true circular arcs.
Start on the revolve axis at one end of the part.
Use arc segments for the rounded end transitions and line segments for the straight side.
Close the sketch back to the axis, then revolve 360 degrees around the vertical axis.
notes: Do not approximate smooth arcs with many polyline points when a sketch arc is supported.
For a full solid of revolution, the profile should be a closed area on one side of the revolve axis.
